General Remarks.

The land sold during the year amounted to 14,451.10 acres, which realized $12,520.52. The quantity of surrendered
land in the hands of the department, in round numbers, is 447,827 acres. The principal outstanding, on account of
Indian lands, amounted to $140,910.93, a considerable portion of which is not yet due.
